description: Lincolnshire County Council is an upper-tier authority (county council). Default is procurement_paid. Pension fund transfers bucket to internal_transfer. REDACTED / accrual rules added if the raw CSV feed exposes them — not all counties do.

rules.reason: Care Act 2014 + UK GDPR redactions — direct payments to individuals (foster carers, SGO recipients, ASC service-user direct payments, CYP direct payments, Staying Put arrangements). Lawfully unnamed. Pattern covers REDACTED, REDACT, [REDACTED], and REDACTED-suffix variants (e.g. 'REDACTED PERSONAL DATA', 'REDACTED - PERSONAL PAYMENT', 'REDACTED - SPECIFIC VENDOR').
Lincolnshire CC Pension Fund is the council's own pensions vehicle — money from the general fund to the pension fund is an internal transfer, not third-party procurement.

Lincolnshire CC uses 6-digit period codes (202412=Dec 2024, 202501=Jan 2025, 202502=Feb 2025) as supplier name when redacting supplier identity for recent months. 55,470 rows / £208.9M / 3 codes. Cannot be aggregated as 'supplier 202501' — treated as redacted-identity per taxonomy ('or the individual's reference code'). Applies only to Lincs.
